During the [[Thrawn campaign]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], a massive '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hettsk]]. The battle was won by [[Thrawn's confederation]] and saw the capture of two [[New Republic pilot/Legends|New Republic pilots]].

==The battle==
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] engaged in a massive [[Space warfare/Legends|space]] and [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground]] battle on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hettsk]] with [[Thrawn's confederation]], in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Borderland Regions]]. The Imperial forces won the day, and captured two [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the process: [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Greni]] and her [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] [[Bross]], both of [[Gold Squadron (New Republic)|Gold Squadron]].<ref name="CM" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We're surrendering. We don't care what you do, just get us off this planet. We'll cooperate, just save us&hellip;|[[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]], feigning surrender to an [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army trooper]]|<ref name="CM" />}}
[[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]] were soon after sent on a [[Mission to Hettsk|mission]] to rescue the two [[New Republic pilot/Legends|New Republic pilots]], and were successful.<ref name="CM" />
